name: dar-nur-schema-tests
description: Banc d'essai hors ligne des migrations Supabase (refonte, étapes 6, 10 et 11) : PGlite + schéma de production figé (baseline.sql) + données réelles. `npm ci` ici, puis `node run.mjs --live` (catalogue public) ou `node run.mjs --data <dossier de sauvegarde>` ; étape 11 : `npm run test:emails`.

scripts.typecheck:emails: tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --target es2022 --lib es2022,dom --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --verbatimModuleSyntax --erasableSyntaxOnly ../../../supabase/functions/_shared/order-emails/brevo.ts ../../../supabase/functions/_shared/order-emails/config.ts ../../../supabase/functions/_shared/order-emails/templates.ts ../../../supabase/functions/_shared/order-emails/types.ts ../../../supabase/functions/_shared/order-emails/webhook.ts ../../../supabase/functions/_shared/order-emails/worker.ts ../../../supabase/functions/order-emails/index.ts ../../../supabase/functions/order-emails-webhook/index.ts deno-shim.d.ts
scripts.test:emails: npm run typecheck:emails && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON email-templates.mjs && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON emails.mjs --live
